items.alt: Comit Capital Trading Insights email — HTML implementation from a supplied design.
items.html:
Why Losing Traders Aren’t
Usually Wrong About The
Market

Dear [redacted]

Most traders don’t blow accounts because they read the chart wrong. They blow accounts because of what happens in the thirty seconds after a trade goes against them. The setup was fine. The analysis was fine. What breaks is the response moving the stop loss “just a little,” doubling the position to “get it back faster,” or closing a winning trade early out of fear it’ll reverse.

This is loss aversion doing exactly what it evolved to do: making losses feel roughly twice as painful as equivalent gains feel good. It’s not a flaw unique to bad traders, it’s a default setting in every human brain. The difference between traders who last and traders who don’t isn’t that one group feels it less. It’s that one group has already decided, before the trade, exactly what they’ll do when it happens.

That’s really what a trading plan is for. Not to predict the market, no plan does that but to remove the decision from the moment you’re least equipped to make it well. When the stop loss is set before entry and never touched afterward, the emotional version of you never gets a vote.

What to watch in yourself: if you’ve ever moved a stop loss further away “just this once,” that’s the moment worth paying attention to not the trade itself.

items.title: Platform Migration Update
items.description: Customer-notice email · HTML implementation.
items.html:
Comit Capital has joined forces with Instant Funding. See what happens to your account from 31 August 2026.
 

BIG CHANGES
ARE COMING

Dear Client

Big changes are coming to Comit Capital, and we’re excited to share the news with you!

Comit Capital has joined forces with Instant Funding. From 31 August 2026, the South African-facing business will operate under the Instant Funding South Africa brand.

Instant Funding is an international prop firm, based in the United Kingdom. It has been operating since 2021 and serves traders across more than 180 countries. This is an exciting opportunity to bring the world-renowned Instant Funding experience to South Africa while continuing to support the trading community we’ve built together through Comit Capital.

As part of this process, responsibility for administering your existing Comit Capital account(s) will migrate on 31 August 2026 from Comit Capital to:

Company name: IF Pro Ltd
Company registration number: 2025-00056
Registered address: The Top Floor, Rodney Court Building, Rodney Bay, Gros Islet, Saint Lucia
Country of registration: Saint Lucia

Following the migration, IF Pro Ltd will be responsible for servicing and administering your account(s) and processing the personal information required for that purpose.

THE BEST PART?

Your journey continues exactly where you left off.

   

If you’re currently on a challenge, you’ll move to an equivalent or better Instant Funding account, with your progress carried across.

And if your challenge account is currently in drawdown, your account will migrate with a 1.5% increase to your balance, and your drawdown will be recalculated.

Already funded? Your account will move to an equivalent funded account, with your account size and withdrawable profit carried across.

If you haven’t reached your target by 21 August 2026, don’t worry - your challenge will not be considered failed. Your current phase and progress will move across to IF Pro Ltd. with you.

Before your first use of the Instant Funding services, you will be asked to review and accept the Instant Funding account terms. The Instant Funding account terms are available here: Instant-Funding-General-Terms-Conditions.pdf

AUTOMATIC MIGRATION &
YOUR RIGHT TO OPT OUT

Unless you opt out by 17:00 SAST on Friday, 28 August 2026, your existing account and the personal information reasonably necessary to service and administer it will be migrated to Instant Funding on 31 August 2026 in terms of section 72(e) of the Protection of Personal Information Act, No. 4 of 2013 ("POPI Act").

You do not need to take any action if you want your account to migrate.

If you do not want your account to migrate, you may opt out free of charge by emailing [contact redacted] with the subject line “OPT OUT - ACCOUNT MIGRATION” and include your full name, your user ID and email address.

We will acknowledge your opt-out request in writing.

If you opt out, your account will not be migrated to Instant Funding for continued servicing and administration. Your Comit Capital account will instead be wound down in accordance with the existing Comit Capital terms. Comit Capital will confirm your final account position and the treatment of any accrued rights or withdrawable amounts separately. Opting out will not, by itself, waive any rights already accrued under your existing terms.

KEY DATES TO REMEMBER

   

21 AUG 2026

The final day to purchase a new Comit Capital account or open new positions.

28 AUG 2026 | 17:00 SAST

Deadline to opt out of migration.

31 AUG 2026

All open trades must be closed and the account migration will take place.

01 SEP 2026

Migrated clients will receive access to their Instant Funding South Africa accounts.

Want to move sooner? You can! Simply close your open positions and contact [contact redacted]. We’ll take care of the transition for you.

HOW YOUR
PERSONAL INFORMATION
WILL BE HANDLED

This notice is to be read in conjunction with the Comit Capital Privacy Policy, available at: comitcapital.com/privacy-policy

The Comit Capital Privacy Policy explains how Comit Capital collects and uses personal information for account registration and administration, security, service delivery and the performance of its contractual obligations. It also provides for information to be shared with service providers and business partners and transferred where appropriate, subject to regulatory safeguards.

To migrate your existing account, Comit Capital will transfer only the personal information reasonably necessary for that purpose. Depending on your account, this may include:

• your name, contact details, country of residence and customer identifiers;
• your account type, account size, phase, status and progress;
• relevant trading-performance, balance, drawdown and withdrawal records;
• support and account correspondence; and
• identity-verification, fraud-prevention and compliance records.

The above information will be used to establish and administer your replacement account, preserve your existing account position, provide support, maintain security, comply with legal requirements and resolve account-related claims.

Your information may be processed in countries where Instant Funding operates. Comit Capital and Instant Funding will apply contractual and organisational safeguards intended to provide protection substantially similar to that required by the POPI Act.

You may request access to or correction of your personal information, raise an objection or submit a privacy complaint by contacting:

Comit Capital Information Officer (until 31 August 2026)
Email: [contact redacted]
Address: 5th Floor Sasol Place, 50 Katherine Street, Wierda Valley, Sandton, Gauteng, South Africa, 2196

Instant Funding Data Controller (from 1 September 2026)
Email: [contact redacted]
Privacy Policy: instantfunding.com/privacy-policy

We’ll keep you updated throughout the process and make sure you have everything you need as we move forward.

We’re really excited about what’s ahead and can’t wait to continue this journey with you as Instant Funding South Africa.

Comit Capital is evolving. Your journey continues.

Welcome to Instant Funding South Africa!
